name: MAR v3.12 simulations
model_or_instrument: Modèle Atmosphérique Régional (MAR) v3.12 forced by ERA5
size_as_stated: 5,384,250 data points spread over 22 years with 92 days in each year and with 14 environmental features from MAR

scales.note: MAR v3.12 run at 6.5 km grid spacing over the Greenland Ice Sheet with daily outputs for JJA 2000-2021.
